description: The nearest primary and secondary schools to a Dutch postcode, with name, address, denomination, pupil count, website, distance in km, and the latest end-of-primary test results (reading and maths share reaching target vs the national share) or secondary exam pass rates, from the national education register. Example: {"postcode":"1011AB"} -> OBS IJplein 0.68 km, De Witte Olifant 0.84 km, ... Returns source and data_as_of (latest register update date among the schools).
name: nl_schools_near_postcode
